notes.title: Child of Light version 1.0.31711 is now available!
notes.notes:
List of Changes:[list]

[*] New: Added Support for Traditional Chinese
[*] New: Added Save Slots
[*] New: Changed Normal and Hard mode names to Casual and Expert
[*] New: Improved error messages for unsupported hardware
[*] Fixed:[/list][olist]
	[*] Various crashes & minor issues
	[*] Framerate issue on certain laptops with dedicated and integrated GPUs
	[*] Localization bugs
	[*] Some visual quality issues
	[*] A rare issue with the Golem’s Plight quest[/olist]
